rule_file_drift_note: empty means every file that implements a rule — the audit rules, the OutcomeVerifier, the Gate, the P0-P3 thresholds — is byte-identical to the freeze
interpretation: `predates_run: true` means the file was edited before the first held-out case was sealed, so the change cannot have been fitted to a held-out result. It does not by itself mean the change was harmless; the reasons are stated in S5B_report.md.
reasons: The post-freeze driver edits made no algorithmic change. `s5b_overhead.py` gained the §14 token class, which S5A had reported as TOKEN_UNAVAILABLE; the API does report usage, so the field was a false statement about the instrument. `s5b_anomaly.py`, `s5b_ablation.py` and `s5b_tables.py` gained measured-zero handling so a class that was injected and never detected reports F1 0.0 rather than an em dash. `s5b_finalize.py` split §20 conditions 2 and 7 so that report drift cannot fail a protocol condition. None of the five changes a fraction, a count or a decision.
